a06.query: Which token embeddings does the ColBERT document encoder remove after projection, and why?
a06.rewritten_query: ColBERT document encoder token embeddings removed after projection why
a06.hypothetical_document: The ColBERT document encoder removes token embeddings corresponding to query terms after projection, specifically those that are not part of the query. This filtering is done because only query-relevant token embeddings are needed for scoring and storage.
